narrative: The cosmic microwave background is framed as the universe's literal baby picture — the oldest observable light whose one-part-in-100,000 quantum fluctuations, amplified by inflation, seeded all subsequent structure including the neural patterns that now observe them. The chapter's central argument is that a person looking at a CMB map is a causal descendant of those fluctuations, making the universe's self-observation not metaphor but a precise description of a physical causal chain spanning fourteen billion years.
